title: Campaign flow: menus, relocation fade, results, ending
acceptance: Full loop start -> L1 -> fade -> L2 -> ending -> results
description: Until real arenas exist (T-0020, T-0027), the flow runs in the code-built sandbox range: title panel, two short stand-in levels that complete when their waves are cleared, brief results, relocation fade, ending, campaign results, back to title. Menu buttons are world-space panels the player shoots. Widened to Core/Game (the sandbox game mode builds what each stage shows).

result.summary: Campaign flow (9e22f91) plus three fixes from the owner's headset tests: panel text lit (909c365), rig placed on the range instead of the Entry map's player start so panels are reachable (a14c5ab), rig on a 1 m mount with a lower objective bulk so all lanes are visible (18f33a7).
result.verification: All 83 ETM tests pass (incl. cannon reach to every button and a clear centre-lane sightline); owner on Quest 3: START button works, all lanes visible.
result.remaining: Owner run through the whole loop (results, relocation fade, Level 2, ending, campaign results); visible pause indicator; failure screen
